}

	law_category = religious
    potential = { has_tribal_government = yes always = no } # ANTIQVITAS mounted-system quarantine
    allow = { has_tribal_government = yes }

    religious_tribe_policy = {
        country_modifier = {
            global_pop_conversion_speed = 0.01
        }
        estate_preferences = {
			clergy_estate
		}
		years = 2
    }
    lip_service_policy = {
        country_modifier = {
            stability_cost_efficiency = 0.2
        }
        estate_preferences = {
			peasants_estate
			burghers_estate
		}
		years = 2
    }
    complete_religious_autonomy_policy = {
        country_modifier = {
            army_maintenance_efficiency = 0.2
        }
		estate_preferences = {
			peasants_estate
			burghers_estate
		}
		years = 2
    }
}

tribal_migration_law = {
	law_category = socioeconomic
    potential = { has_tribal_government = yes country_type = pop always = no } # ANTIQVITAS mounted-system quarantine
    allow = { has_tribal_government = yes country_type = pop }

    frequent_migration_policy = {
        country_modifier = {
            army_movement_speed = 0.1
            migrate_pop_based_country_cost_modifier = -0.25
        }
		estate_preferences = {
			nobles_estate
		}
        years = 2
    }
    seasonal_travel_policy = {
        country_modifier = {
            migrate_pop_based_country_cost_modifier = -0.5
        }
		estate_preferences = {
			burghers_estate
		}
        years = 2
    }
    permanent_settlement_policy = {
        allow = {
            capital = { OR = { owner = root has_owner = no } }
        }
        country_modifier = {
            stability_decay = 0.001
            migrate_pop_based_country_cost_modifier = 1
        }
		estate_preferences = {
			clergy_estate
		}
        on_fully_activated = {
            change_country_type = location
        }
        years = 5
    }
}

tribal_cultural_identity_law = {
	law_category = socioeconomic
    potential = { has_tribal_government = yes always = no } # ANTIQVITAS mounted-system quarantine
    allow = { has_tribal_government = yes }

    dynastic_lineage_policy = {
        country_modifier = {
            monthly_towards_centralization = societal_value_monthly_move
            global_crown_estate_power = 0.1
        }
		estate_preferences = {
			crown_estate
		}
        years = 20
    }
    rule_by_the_public_policy = {
        country_modifier = {
            monthly_towards_communalism = societal_value_monthly_move
            stability_decay = -0.00025
        }
		estate_preferences = {
			peasants_estate
		}
        years = 20
    }
    state_of_faith_policy = {
        country_modifier = {
            monthly_towards_traditionalist = societal_value_monthly_move
            tolerance_own = 1
        }
		estate_preferences = {
			clergy_estate
		}
        years = 20
    }
    tribal_identity_policy = {
        country_modifier = {
            monthly_towards_traditional_economy = societal_value_monthly_move
            monthly_tribal_cohesion = 0.5
        }
		estate_preferences = {
			peasants_estate
			nobles_estate
		}
        years = 2
    }
}

tribal_modernization_law = {
	law_category = socioeconomic
    potential = { has_tribal_government = yes always = no } # ANTIQVITAS mounted-system quarantine
    allow = {
        has_tribal_government = yes
        NOT = { has_policy = tribal_identity_policy }
        country_type = location
        gold >= 100
    }

    modernize_into_monarchy_policy = {
        allow = { has_policy = dynastic_lineage_policy }
        years = 20
        country_modifier = {
            monthly_towards_aristocracy = societal_value_large_monthly_move
            monthly_tribal_cohesion = -1
        }
		estate_preferences = {
			nobles_estate
		}
        on_fully_activated = {
			add_government_power = government_power_extreme_bonus
            add_gold = -100
            change_government_type = government_type:monarchy
        }
    }
    modernize_into_republic_policy = {
        allow = { has_policy = rule_by_the_public_policy }
        years = 20
        country_modifier = {
            monthly_towards_plutocracy = societal_value_large_monthly_move
            monthly_tribal_cohesion = -1
        }
		estate_preferences = {
			burghers_estate
		}
        on_fully_activated = {
			add_government_power = government_power_extreme_bonus
            add_gold = -100
            change_government_type = government_type:republic
        }
    }
    modernize_into_theocracy_policy = {
        allow = { has_policy = state_of_faith_policy }
        years = 20
        country_modifier = {
            monthly_towards_spiritualist = societal_value_large_monthly_move
            monthly_tribal_cohesion = -1
        }
		estate_preferences = {
			clergy_estate
		}
        on_fully_activated = {
			add_government_power = government_power_extreme_bonus
            add_gold = -100
            change_government_type = government_type:theocracy
        }
    }
}
